subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: Should this PR wait for live Telegram owner-session delivery proof, or may maintainers accept source-level and test proof only?
rationale: The code path is plausible and well scoped, but the changed behavior is user-visible Telegram/session delivery and the requested Mantis proof did not produce an artifact.

options.title: Require Live Delivery Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

options.title: Accept Source-Only Risk
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge with source and regression-test evidence only, while owning the risk that real transport/session delivery still misroutes or drops the completion.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Telegram Liveness Work
options.body: Pause this PR and move its useful tests into the broader Telegram detached-subagent liveness and terminal-notification issue.

recommendation.title: Require Live Delivery Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has adjacent history across heartbeat and subagent completion delivery, and the remaining decision is proof sufficiency for that cross-path behavior.
